cases.symptom: Crash worker subprocess returned 1 with empty stderr; in-process replay raised KILL_SWITCH_GATE_DENIED:KILL_SWITCH_EVIDENCE_NOT_TRUSTED:MISSING.
cases.cause: The parent autouse fixture anchors the kill switch only in the parent process. The child is a new process and therefore reads the canonical root, which has no attested ACTIVE state.
cases.fix: tests/ops/_current_full_system_offline_e2e_crash_child_runner_v1.py re-anchors risk_gate._KILL_SWITCH_STATE_ROOT to a per-test root and the parent writes an attested ACTIVE state there before spawn. Same pattern as tests/ops/_current_productive_post_hard_crash_harness_v1.py. Production kill-switch code unchanged.

cases.symptom: After a crash before durable consume, the restart raised GLOBAL_REPLAY_DENIED:OWNER_AUTHORIZATION_IDENTITY instead of completing one fake POST.
cases.cause: GlobalVenueEffectAuthorityLedgerV1.claim_v1 writes the OWNER_AUTHORIZATION_IDENTITY marker when the claim is created, which is before transport. A later process cannot claim the same owner authorization. The first claim stays CLAIMED and unresolved.
cases.fix: Restart tests now assert the replay deny, zero fake posts, and the same unresolved CLAIMED claim. The ledger was not weakened.

cases.symptom: Second chain raised GlobalVenueEffectReplayDeniedError instead of CurrentProductiveOneShotFreshEnvelopeJoinError CONSUMED_PERMIT.
cases.cause: B6 denies the replay at the global ledger claim, before the one-shot join checks the consumed permit.
cases.fix: The test asserts GLOBAL_REPLAY_DENIED:OWNER_AUTHORIZATION_IDENTITY, one fake post, and no unresolved claim after the successful first chain.

cases.cause: All 12 section_11_14_live_handoff files passed on the unchanged production modules.
